description: This file defines the XXH64 class implementing a 64-bit hash function based on xxHash algorithm, including methods for hashing integers, longs, byte arrays, and UTF8 strings, with internal constants and utility functions.

classes.name: XXH64
classes.description: A class implementing the xxHash64 hashing algorithm with methods for hashing various data types and internal constants.

methods.name: hashInt
methods.description: Hashes an integer input with the instance seed or a provided seed.

methods.name: hashLong
methods.description: Hashes a long input with the instance seed or a provided seed.

methods.name: hashUnsafeWords
methods.description: Hashes data from a memory region aligned to 8 bytes.

methods.name: hashUnsafeBytes
methods.description: Hashes arbitrary bytes from a memory region.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the XXH64 object.
